intent: Teach animal recognition plus silent movement, trunk use, tallest-branch leaves, distinct stripe patterns, watcher roles and positions, held bamboo, searching without implied success and tracks without inferred ownership.
picturePurpose: Original tiger/zebra noun recognition, three reversible branch/viewpoint/between diagrams and three exact evidence selections; picture never proves silence or universal stripe-pattern claims.

workshop.title: 动物观察：位置、动作与结果
workshop.instruction: 辨认动物，切换观察者和枝条，再检查原句有没有说明结果。
